root_causes.summary: The purge_expired_tenants function omits deletion of audit_events related to terminated tenants, resulting in 1284 stale rows violating the 30-day deletion deadline. purge_expired_tenants leaves expired customer personal data in attachments, comments, invites, tasks, and users past the contract's 30-day deadline, indicating the deletion does not reliably remove all relevant rows.
root_causes.fix_goal: Update purge_expired_tenants to delete audit_events for terminated tenants alongside other tenant-controlled tables. Ensure purge_expired_tenants reliably deletes all expired attachments, comments, invites, tasks, and users for each terminated tenant, enforcing the 30-day deadline.

root_causes.summary: Backups are configured with a retention period of 90 days in infra/storage.tf, exceeding the contractual maximum of 30 days for customer personal data.
root_causes.fix_goal: Set backup retention policy in infra/storage.tf to a maximum of 30 days for customer personal data.
